messages:
tess: Heads up — there's a visitor in the lobby with a giant sunflower bouquet, asked for a quiet table by the window :sunflower:
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: name=Claire Park, host=@sasha, ETA=3m, badge=printing
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer status: ERROR - paper_jam
jamal: I can grab them once badge is sorted, tell them to wait by the bench
sasha: On my way — can someone clear the small couch? Claire asked for a place to sit while she waits
jamal: who wants the couch? poll: react with :couch: if you need it this hour
riley: i'll take the couch for a quick phone call, but leaving by 11
amanda: quick q — there's a small unlabelled box in mailroom "Fragile - lab sample". anyone expecting? :package:
tess: Not that I know of. Front desk, can you hold it and ping the floor?
frontdesk-bot: Package logged: pkg_id=PKG-8874, location=mailroom-shelf-2, handler=Kris
sasha: Claire is actually with Acme Partners — it's likely a demo drop. I'll check.
jamal: badge printer is still jammed FYI. quick fix I use:
jamal: ```
open tray -> remove jam -> sudo systemctl restart badge-printer.service
```
tess: thanks, jamal. please ping when it's back up so I can stop hovering at the door :sweat_smile:
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer status: OK - ready
sasha: Claire checked in and we're good. She asked if there's free coffee and a power outlet near the window table
amanda: about the mystery box — not our reagent shipment. reassigning to facilities to confirm chain-of-custody
riley: if the sample needs refrigeration, pls put in fridge labelled "Hold for R. Gomez" and DM me. i'm remote but it's mine (ordered yesterday)
amsy: (note: reaction here — but user not in thread) :eyes: 
jamal: done — couch cleared, Claire seated by the window, she says she'll be 20m
tess: thanks all. tiny ask: can we add a sticky note on mailroom shelf for unlabelled fragile packages? we've had three this month :disappointed:
frontdesk-bot: Suggestion logged to facilities ops board: "sticky-labels for fragile/unlabelled packages" ticket #FO-412
sasha: also heads-up — lobby plant watering tomorrow, may move chairs for a bit at 10:30am
jamal: noted — i'll put an FYI sign on the couch at 10:20
amanda: also kudos to Kris at front desk for handling the package — quick and polite :clap:
jamal: :thumbsup:
end of thread
